title: Code for: Spontaneous reasoning reorders language models’ gains from chain-of-thought

creators.name: Ariel, Dean
creators.affiliation: Ben-Gurion University of the Negev; Clalit Health Services

creators.name: Balicer, Ran
creators.affiliation: Clalit Research Institute, Innovation Division, Clalit Health Services; The Ivan and Francesca Berkowitz Family Living Laboratory Collaboration at Harvard Medical School and Clalit Research Institute; School of Public Health, Faculty of Health Sciences, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev

description: Code for generation, scoring and every analysis of the paper. The study measures the gain of chain-of-thought prompting against two direct-answer baselines, a requested answer and a forced answer, on GSM8K, MATH-500, BIG-Bench Hard and HotpotQA under many prompt templates. It includes a pilot tool that reports the share of long requested answers, the reliability of gains across templates, and who benefits under each baseline. The model outputs, scores and per-draw accuracies are available from the corresponding author on request.
